from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RightOfUseAsset(BaseModel):
    """Right-of-use asset values extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., Q1 2024)")
    beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="Beginning balance of right-of-use assets if available")
    ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of right-of-use assets if available")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., 元)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    right_of_use_assets: list[RightOfUseAsset]
